lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，发出微弱嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Slowly crawl, making a weak hissing sound.

lines.zh: 肌肉松弛，拖着身体前进。
lines.en: Muscles loose, dragging its body forward.
Gulping at decayed flesh, making gurgling sounds.

lines.zh: 脚上的布条在沙上拖出线。
lines.en: The cloth on my foot drags a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边嗅着空气。
lines.en: I walk and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 啃咬地面，试图找到食物。
lines.en: Biting the ground, trying to find food.
Staring at the player, moving slowly closer.

lines.zh: 拖动着伤口，发出痛苦声。
lines.en: Dragging its wounds, making painful sounds.
Gulping at a corpse, making gurgling sounds.
One shoulder crooked, swaying with each step.

lines.zh: 布条缠着的脚在沙上拖行。
lines.en: Cloth-wrapped feet drag through the sand.
Staring at the ground, eyes hollow.

lines.zh: 靠在墙上，显得疲惫不堪。
lines.en: Leaning against a wall, looking exhausted.
I stand in place and sway slowly.
Staring at something, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，脖子快断了。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you; my neck is nearly snapped.
Bending down, as if searching for something.
Staring at the wall, eyes hollow.
Staring at the player, with a fierce gaze.

lines.zh: 我的衬衫前襟全是干血。
lines.en: My shirt front is stiff with dried blood.
Staring at the player, trying to get closer.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，接近玩家。
lines.en: Making a low hissing sound, approaching the player.
Makes a warning hiss towards the player.
Staring at the player, looking angry.
Makes a threatening hiss towards the player.
Staring at the player, trying to attack.

lines.zh: 破烂的衬衫上都是干血。
lines.en: Dried blood all over this torn shirt.
Something twitches beneath the rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙，手印留在灰上。
lines.en: I steady myself on the wall, leaving a print in the dust.

lines.zh: 膝盖朝后折了一下，站不直。
lines.en: My knee folds backward and will not straighten.

lines.zh: 腐烂开始吞噬我的意志。
腐肉就是我的天赐之物。

lines.en: I am the embodiment of decay.

lines.zh: 撞在砖墙上，牙掉了一颗。
lines.en: I hit the brick wall and lose a tooth.
I collide with a hard obstacle.

lines.zh: 撞击声宣告了我的碰撞。

lines.en: I collide with a living creature.
The collision throws me off balance.
I seek a mate for breeding.

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类进行交配。

lines.en: Kin with a broken leg, where are you?

lines.zh: 吃掉你，剩下的就剩我了。

lines.en: This corpse is still wrapped in a blanket.

lines.zh: 这块肉嚼起来没什么味道。
lines.en: This meat has almost no taste.

lines.zh: 风一转，汗味飘到我脸上。
lines.en: The wind shifts and sweat reaches my face.

lines.zh: 你敲镐的声音停了，我记住了。
lines.en: Your pickaxe stopped, and I know where.

lines.zh: 你身上的汗味比腐肉香。
lines.en: Your sweat smells better than rot.
Run, it makes the chase better.

lines.zh: 你的脚步把灰尘扬起来了。
lines.en: Your steps are kicking up dust.
That hide is not fully rotted yet. Good.

lines.zh: 你身上的血腥味比腐肉香。
lines.en: Your blood smells sweeter than carrion.

lines.zh: 我听见你用镐敲石头的声。
lines.en: I hear you tapping stone with a pick.

lines.zh: 躲进屋里，门也挡不住我。
lines.en: Hide indoors; a door will not stop me.
You will soon be a walker.

lines.zh: 我的爪子会卸下你的骨头。
lines.en: My claws will strip your bones.
I stop between steps to let the fear build.
I will keep your boots for myself.
After the bite, the wound splits open.

lines.zh: 你还能站着，真让我意外。
lines.en: You still stand. That surprises me.
The pain will make you scream.

lines.zh: 我不需要瞄准，我只需要靠近。
lines.en: I do not aim. I only close the distance.
Your legs will give out first.
I bite through the strap on your shoulder.
Both rows of teeth sink into your shoulder!
You are bitten. You will not get far!

lines.zh: 撕咬的伤，会一直烂下去！
lines.en: A mauled wound rots on and on!
One rake of my nails and you limp!
Do not scream; it only sounds worse!
Once I bite, I do not let go!

lines.zh: 我从土里翻出来，指甲先出。
lines.en: I claw out of the soil, nails first.

lines.zh: 我是这具行尸的第十六种模样。
lines.en: I am this walker's sixteenth face.

lines.zh: 全群系都有我们，不缺这一个。
lines.en: We walk every biome. This one is no rarity.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我们从土里翻出来。
lines.en: Night falls, and we claw out of the soil.

lines.zh: 两只一起走，总有个照应。
lines.en: Two of us walk together; one watches for the other.

lines.zh: 河水灌进肺里，我还在走。
lines.en: River water fills my lungs; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 第三支箭，扎在同一个洞。
lines.en: The third arrow hit the same hole.
So hungry I would bite myself.

lines.zh: 雷把我烧焦一半，我还在走。
lines.en: The bolt charred half of me; I still walk.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，连骨头都没剩。
lines.en: I fell, and not even bones remain.
